rules.name: target=_blank Without rel=noopener
rules.recommendation: Links opening in a new tab need rel="noopener noreferrer" so the target page cannot manipulate window.opener.

rules.name: External Script Without Subresource Integrity
rules.recommendation: Third-party script loaded without integrity="sha384-..." trusts the CDN entirely. Add a SubResource Integrity hash.

rules.name: Form Submitted Over HTTP
rules.recommendation: Form posts over plain HTTP leak credentials on the wire. Use https:// or a same-origin path.
